card.alien_drone.desc: A field-shielded collector that files everything under 'specimen'.
card.alien_drone.name: Harvest Drone
card.alien_grey.desc: It means you no harm — the dampening field it projects on arrival (−1 <attack> to the nearest foe) is strictly for science.
card.alien_grey.name: Grey Visitor
card.alien_mothership.desc: A city-sized hull blotting out the sky. Its fabricator bays release a Harvest Drone at every round's end — and its command saucer detaches when the hull falls. Destroy BOTH to win.
card.alien_mothership.name: The Mothership
card.alien_mothership_core.desc: The Mothership's escaping brain — small, furious, and armed with both beam arrays. Shoot it down to win.

card.alien_replicator.desc: Break it and the nanite swarm simply reassigns: releases 2 Scout Probes on death.
card.alien_replicator.name: Replicator Frame
card.alien_saucer.desc: Twin beam arrays, twin targets: fires twice each round.

card.alien_shieldnode.desc: A floating generator pylon. On arrival it projects a Barrier over 2 random allies.

card.alien_vivisector.desc: Its instruments are very precise and very unpleasant: whatever it cuts is left Withered.
card.alien_vivisector.name: Vivisector
card.beast_alpha.desc: The pack answers to one voice. Every kill feeds him: heals 3 whenever he slays a unit. Bring him down to win.
card.beast_alpha.name: Fenrik, the Alpha
card.beast_ancient.desc: Hunters have carved a hundred scars into its hide, and each one made it meaner: +1 <attack> every time it takes a hit. Destroy it to win.

card.beast_ape.desc: Beats its chest on arrival, rallying the whole pack with +1 <attack>.

card.beast_bear.desc: Slow to anger, impossible to calm: +1 <attack> every time it takes a hit.
card.beast_bear.name: Rageclaw Bear
card.beast_behemoth.desc: A siege engine with a heartbeat. +1 <attack> whenever it takes a hit.
card.beast_behemoth.name: Thornmane Behemoth
card.beast_boar.desc: Hurting it is a mistake: +2 <attack> every time it takes a hit.
card.beast_boar.name: Ironhide Boar
card.beast_direwolf.desc: Never hunts alone — a Ravenous Wolf lopes in beside it when it arrives.
card.beast_direwolf.name: Direwolf Packlead
card.beast_hyena.desc: Laughs at every funeral — gains +1 <attack> whenever ANY unit dies, friend or foe.
card.beast_hyena.name: Cackling Hyena
card.beast_panther.desc: A blur of muscle and malice: +15% dodge and +15% crit chance.
card.beast_panther.name: Shadowfang Panther

card.beast_wolf.desc: A kill only sharpens its hunger: gains Frenzied (+1 <attack>, +1 <speed>) whenever it slays a unit.
card.beast_wolf.name: Ravenous Wolf
card.bishop.desc: A ranged attacker. Strikes the enemy with the lowest <health> from afar.

card.bishop_pawn.desc: A holy knight that strikes the nearest enemy.

card.bishop_queen.desc: A divine being. Blesses all allies with +1 <attack> and smites the deadliest enemy.

card.corp_ceo.desc: The hiring pipeline never sleeps (an Unpaid Intern onboards every round) and every hostile takeover (kill) is +1 <attack>. Terminating him triggers the severance clause — destroy THAT too to win.
card.corp_ceo.name: The CEO
card.corp_cfo.desc: Every attack against the company is a line item, and she cuts budgets accordingly: attackers lose 1 <attack> per swing. Zero her out to win.
card.corp_cfo.name: The CFO
card.corp_consultant.desc: Delivers a 200-slide efficiency review on arrival: EVERY unit on the field — both sides — loses 1 <attack>. Invoices separately.
card.corp_consultant.name: External Consultant
card.corp_golden_parachute.desc: He's escaping with the severance package! Fast, slippery (+25% dodge), and worth eight figures. Ground him before he reaches the helipad to win.
card.corp_golden_parachute.name: The Golden Parachute
card.corp_hr.desc: Assigns the nearest opponent mandatory training videos: Blinded for their next 2 attacks (50% miss).
card.corp_hr.name: HR Representative
card.corp_intern.desc: Compensated in experience. The exit interview yields valuable insights: the company draws a card when they quit (die).
card.corp_intern.name: Unpaid Intern

card.corp_lawyer.name: Legal Counsel
card.corp_middle_manager.desc: Calls a synergy alignment huddle on arrival: +1 <attack> to the whole org chart.
card.corp_middle_manager.name: Middle Manager

card.corp_sales_shark.name: Sales Shark
card.corp_security.desc: You're going to need a visitor badge for that assault.

card.cult_bloodpriest.name: Blood Priest

card.cult_elder_god.name: Vhal'Zhoth, the Awakened
card.cult_flesh_horror.desc: An answered prayer, regrettably. Feeds on what it kills: heals 3 per victim.
card.cult_flesh_horror.name: Flesh Horror
card.cult_hierophant.desc: He has spent forty years digging for something under this map, growing +1 <attack> per offered ally. Kill him and you'll meet it. Destroy WHAT COMES AFTER to win.
card.cult_hierophant.name: Hierophant Ozmun
card.cult_high_priest.desc: Every fallen follower is a coin in his purse: +1 <attack> and 2 healing per ally death. Strike him down to win.

card.cult_horrorspawn.desc: A knot of eyes and appetite, freshly through the veil.
card.cult_horrorspawn.name: Horrorspawn

card.harpy_fledgling.name: Harpy Fledgling

card.harpy_shrieker.name: Shrieker Harpy

card.harpy_stormwing.name: Stormwing Matron

card.harpy_talon.name: Twin-Talon Harpy

card.insect_mantis_prime.name: Mantis Prime

card.insect_vespid.name: Vespid Stinger

card.insect_worker.name: Carapace Worker

card.mimic_table.name: Table Mimic
card.mortis.desc: The deathless sovereign of the undead, knitting his bones whole with every strike. Destroy him to win. Starts each round with 5 <shield>.
card.mortis.name: Mortis, the Undying
card.obsidian_behemoth.desc: A vast slab of living obsidian that anchors the legion. Bring it down to win. Slow, but starts each round with 8 <shield>.
card.obsidian_behemoth.name: Obsidian Behemoth
card.pawn.desc: A humble foot soldier. Attacks the nearest enemy.
card.pawn.name: Pawn
card.pawn_pawn.desc: Two footmen fighting back to back. Strikes the nearest enemy.
card.pawn_pawn.name: Warrior
card.pawn_queen.desc: All <pawn> allies gain +1 <attack> and +1 <speed> while this is in play. Cast Rally to permanently boost a <pawn>'s <attack> and <speed>. Strikes the nearest enemy.
card.pawn_queen.name: Commander
card.pawn_rook.desc: A ranged attacker. Locks onto the enemy with the lowest <health>. Starts each round with 1 <shield>.
card.pawn_rook.name: Barracks
card.pirate_captain.desc: Half legend, half rum, all menace. Every kill goes in the ledger: +1 <attack> per unit he fells. Send him to the depths to win.
card.pirate_captain.name: Captain Rummy Bones
card.pirate_cook.desc: Nobody knows what's in the pot. It works: every crewmate heals 1 at round's end.
card.pirate_cook.name: Sea Cook Gruel
card.pirate_deck_cannon.desc: Bolted down, loaded up, and pointed at your problems.
card.pirate_deck_cannon.name: Deck Cannon
card.pirate_deckhand.desc: Paid in grog, fights like it.
card.pirate_deckhand.name: Scurvy Deckhand
card.pirate_dreadbeard.desc: His beard has its own bounty. Every strike keelhauls its victim: −1 <attack> and −1 <speed>. Sink him to win.
card.pirate_dreadbeard.name: Admiral Dreadbeard
card.pirate_first_mate.desc: Keeps a notch on her blade for every kill — and every notch is +1 <attack>.
card.pirate_first_mate.name: First Mate Cutlass
card.pirate_gunner.desc: Won the ship's cannon in a card game. The cannon disagrees, but fires anyway.
card.pirate_gunner.name: Cannon Gunner
card.pirate_kraken.desc: Every crew owes it something, and today it collects from YOU. Three tentacles, three strikes a round, each seizing a fresh victim. Destroy it to win.
card.pirate_kraken.name: The Kraken, Debt Collector
card.pirate_parrot.desc: Knows exactly one hundred insults and no restraint: the nearest foe loses 1 <attack> out of sheer demoralization.
card.pirate_parrot.name: Foul-Mouthed Parrot
card.pirate_powder_monkey.desc: Carries the powder keg. Drops the powder keg. On death: 1 damage to EVERY other unit on the field — theirs AND yours.
card.pirate_powder_monkey.name: Powder Monkey
card.pirate_swashbuckler.desc: Fights from the rigging, the railing, and once, memorably, the chandelier (+20% dodge).
card.pirate_swashbuckler.name: Swashbuckler
card.queen.desc: The most powerful piece on the board. Always targets the highest-cost enemy, neutralising the most valuable target first.
card.queen.name: Queen
card.queen_queen.desc: The ultimate champion. Inspires all allies with +1 <attack> and cuts down the deadliest enemy.
card.queen_queen.name: Hero
card.rook.desc: A stalwart fortress. Locks onto the enemy with the lowest <health> from afar. Starts each round with 2 <shield>.
card.rook.name: Rook
card.rook_queen.desc: A royal stronghold. Fortifies all allies with +2 Max <hp> and holds the line against the sturdiest enemy. Starts each round with 2 <shield>.
card.rook_queen.name: Castle
card.rook_rook.desc: An immovable gun emplacement. Locks onto the sturdiest enemy and starts each round with 4 <shield>.
card.rook_rook.name: Turret
card.skeleton_grunt.desc: A reanimated soldier that simply refuses to stay down.
card.skeleton_grunt.name: Skeleton Grunt
card.slime_amalgam.desc: Every slime that ever died in this bog is still in there, somewhere. Absorbs each fallen ally for +1 <attack> and +2 <health>. Destroy it to win.
card.slime_amalgam.name: The Amalgam
card.slime_big.desc: A wobbling wall of goo. Splits into 2 Green Slimes on death.
card.slime_big.name: Giant Slime
card.slime_blue.desc: So springy that blows tend to glance right off (+20% dodge).
card.slime_blue.name: Bouncing Slime
card.slime_droplet.desc: The smallest a slime can get. Barely a threat — but they do add up.
card.slime_droplet.name: Slime Droplet
card.slime_gluttonous.desc: Slurps up every fallen ally: +1 <attack> and +1 <health> whenever one dies.
card.slime_gluttonous.name: Gluttonous Slime
card.slime_green.desc: Pop it and it just gets smaller: splits into 2 Droplets on death.
card.slime_green.name: Green Slime
card.slime_king_gel.desc: Sovereign of the ooze, wearing a crown it digested along with its previous owner. Grows crueler (+1 <attack>) each time a subject pops. Cut it down to win.
card.slime_king_gel.name: The Royal Gel
card.slime_magma.desc: Runs hot. Bursts on death, scalding every opposing unit for 1.
card.slime_magma.name: Magma Slime
card.slime_mega.desc: A rolling hill with appetite. Splits into 2 Giant Slimes on death — killing it is only the beginning.
card.slime_mega.name: Colossal Slime
card.slime_overlord.desc: An ocean pretending to be a monster. Slimes whatever it strikes — and killing it only frees what boils at its core. Destroy BOTH forms to win.
card.slime_overlord.name: Slimeon, the Boundless
card.slime_overlord_reborn.desc: The Overlord's boiling core, freed of its bulk — twice as fast, twice as angry, striking twice a round. This one stays dead.
card.slime_overlord_reborn.name: Slimeon Reborn
card.slime_sticky.desc: Leaves clinging goo on whatever it slaps: its target is Slimed (−1 <speed>).
card.slime_sticky.name: Sticky Slime
card.slime_toxic.desc: A bubbling vat on the move — applies 2 Poison to whatever it hits.
card.slime_toxic.name: Toxic Slime
card.stone_sentinel.desc: An ancient guardian â€” slow, but nearly immovable. Starts each round with 3 <shield>.
card.stone_sentinel.name: Stone Sentinel
card.stoneborn_warlord.desc: An immense living monolith that anchors the legion. Bring it down to win. Slow, but starts each round with 6 <shield>.
card.stoneborn_warlord.name: Stoneborn Warlord
card.titanus.desc: A mountain that walks — the eldest of the stoneborn. Bring it down to win. Immensely slow, but starts each round with 10 <shield>.
card.titanus.name: Titanus, the World-Render
card.troll_ancient_gorge.desc: A landslide that got up. Heals 4 at every round's end and grows +1 <attack> per wound taken. Outpace the healing to win.
card.troll_ancient_gorge.name: Old Gorge, the Unkillable
card.troll_berserker.desc: The wounds close as fast as you make them — heals 2 each round and hits harder (+1 <attack>) every time you try.
card.troll_berserker.name: Troll Berserker
card.troll_bridgekeeper.desc: Nobody crosses without paying. Heals 2 at every round's end — arguments with it tend to outlast the arguer.
card.troll_bridgekeeper.name: Bridgekeeper
card.troll_chieftain.desc: Has been killed eleven times and finds it increasingly funny. Heals 3 at every round's end. Make the twelfth stick to win.
card.troll_chieftain.name: Chieftain Gnarl
card.troll_shaman.desc: Chews the right herbs and spits the wrong ones: every troll heals 1 at round's end.
card.troll_shaman.name: Moss Shaman
card.troll_stonehide.desc: Skin like a quarry wall, patience like one too.
card.troll_stonehide.name: Stonehide Troll
card.troll_whelp.desc: Young, dumb, and already regrowing: heals 1 at every round's end.
card.troll_whelp.name: Troll Whelp
card.vampire_lord.desc: A noble of the night that drains 2 <hp> from its prey with every attack.
card.vampire_lord.name: Vampire Lord

status.fire_blessing.desc: For 2 turns: +2 <attack>, and this unit is treated as a <fire> unit.

status.mending_barrier.desc: Blocks the next attack that would deal damage to this unit, and heals it 1 <health> at the start of each round while it holds. A blocked strike reads as a Miss; a harmless whiff doesn't spend the Barrier.
status.mending_barrier.name: Mending Barrier
status.poison.desc: When this unit activates, it suffers damage equal to the poison count; then the count drops by 1.
status.poison.name: Poison
status.slimed.desc: Clinging goo drags every movement: −1 <speed> per stack.
status.slimed.name: Slimed
status.stalwart_barrier.desc: Blocks the next attack that would damage this unit's <health>, and grants +1 <shield> while it holds. Damage absorbed by <shield> passes through and doesn't spend the Barrier.
status.stalwart_barrier.name: Stalwart Barrier
status.swift_barrier.desc: Blocks the next attack that would deal damage to this unit, and grants +2 <speed> while it holds. A blocked strike reads as a Miss; a harmless whiff doesn't spend the Barrier.
status.swift_barrier.name: Swift Barrier
status.tailwind.desc: Riding the gale: +2 <speed> per stack while it lasts.
status.tailwind.name: Tailwind
status.umbral_barrier.desc: Blocks the next attack that would deal damage to this unit. While it holds, units striking the carrier lose 1 <attack>. A blocked strike reads as a Miss; a harmless whiff doesn't spend the Barrier.
status.umbral_barrier.name: Umbral Barrier
